stem.en: Voter X lives in a country with many parties. Voter Y lives in a country with one party. Both have voting rights. What is the main difference for them?

text.en: Only Voter X has the right to vote
Voter X must vote more often than Voter Y
Voter Y's one vote counts for more than X's vote
Only Voter X can choose between parties

explanation.en: A vote is a real choice only when there is more than one option. With many parties, Voter X can choose between them. With one party, Voter Y holds the right to vote but has no choice of party.

hints.en: What can a voter do with several parties that cannot be done with one?
